name: Yoram Hazony

lean.basis: Leading theorist of national conservatism (The Virtue of Nationalism, 2018; Conservatism: A Rediscovery, 2022); an aide to Likud leader Benjamin Netanyahu in the early 1990s; chairs the foundation behind the NatCon conferences, where Republican officials including JD Vance, Marco Rubio and Russ Vought speak.

sources.title: National Conservatism Asserts Its Dominance in Trump's Washington — AP via US News

current_role: Chairman of the Edmund Burke Foundation (which runs the National Conservatism Conference); president of the Herzl Institute in Jerusalem
summary: Yoram Hazony is an Israeli-American philosopher and political theorist, born in Israel in 1964 and raised in the US. He founded the Shalem Center in Jerusalem (1994) and, with Ofir Haivry, the Herzl Institute (2012). In 2019 he and David Brog set up the Edmund Burke Foundation, whose National Conservatism conferences have become a main venue of the Trump-era right; his 2018 book The Virtue of Nationalism is the movement's core text.
